UNITED STATES · 09:35 UTC

Trump says Iran’s missile arsenal reduced, drone production hampered

The United States and Israel began strikes on Iran in late February 2026.
President Trump told a rally in Ohio that Iran’s missile stocks had been cut and electricity shortages now limited its drone output. He repeated that Iran would never obtain a nuclear weapon. Treasury Secretary Bessent said Tehran could no longer pay its troops or obtain dollars and had cut funding to its proxies. Ambassador Huckabee said only Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu knew whether more military action would follow.
